description: 8 retrieval probes for google/gson — a small Apache-2.0 Java JSON serialization library with anonymous inner classes, wildcard generics, lambda expressions, and enum-with-abstract-method-bodies

probes.query: how does Gson handle null values during serialization
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: serializeNulls() at line 271 enables null serialization; GsonBuilder fluent API

probes.query: how does Gson resolve the constructor for generic collection types
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: get(TypeToken<T>) at line 92 returns lambda-based ObjectConstructor; core of Gson's collection instantiation logic using Java 8 lambdas

probes.query: how does the JSON streaming reader extract string tokens
probes.notes: NL behavior probe: nextString() at line 951 reads and returns the next string value from the JSON stream
Symbol-anchored probe: getType() at line 166 returns the runtime Type captured by the anonymous TypeToken subclass
Symbol-anchored probe: registerTypeAdapter(Type, Object) at line 739 is the primary extension point for custom serializers/deserializers
Symbol-anchored probe: UPPER_CAMEL_CASE at line 52 is an enum constant with its own translateName body — exercises enum-with-per-constant-class-body parsing

probes.query: anonymous TypeAdapter implementation for BitSet serialization
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: BIT_SET at line 89 is a static field initialized with an anonymous class expression `new TypeAdapter<BitSet>() { ... }` — exercises the Java grammar rule for anonymous class instantiation with parameterized supertype, which must parse the class body as an anonymous class body rather than a regular object creation expression

probes.query: LinkedTreeMap constructor with custom comparator and null values support
probes.notes: Grammar-edge-case probe: LinkedTreeMap at line 44 uses the lower-bounded wildcard `Comparator<? super K>` in its constructor signature (line 92) and as a field type (line 54) — exercises the Java grammar production for wildcard type arguments with `super` bound
